newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani cotton close lower on ginners' selling.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani cotton close lower on ginners' selling.

text.p: Pakistani cotton rates dropped at Tuesday's close on ginners' selling, dealers at the private Karachi Cotton Association (KCA) said.
Ginners, holding back 1.6 million 375-lb bales from the 1996/97 (July-June) crop on hope of firmer prices, had begun selling at lower prices, dealer Abdul Qadir at the KCA said.
In the kerb market, NIAB-78 was quoted at 2,200/2,325 rupees per maund (37.32 kg), K-68 at 2,475/2,500 and MNH-93 at 2,475/2,525, the dealer said.
